detail.zh: 资料、数据库与现有系统

q.zh: 可以接入我们已有的系统吗？
q.en: Can it connect to our existing systems?

a.zh: 可以。评估阶段会确认数据来源、接口和权限，优先使用现有数据库、文档与业务系统。
a.en: Yes. The assessment covers data sources, interfaces and permissions, starting with the systems and documents you already use.

q.zh: 如何保证答案和结果可靠？
q.en: How do you make results reliable?

a.zh: 使用企业自己的资料，结合引用溯源、规则校验和人工复核点。无法确认的任务交还业务负责人处理。
a.en: We use your own sources, citations, validation rules and human review. Uncertain tasks return to a business owner.

q.en: When can we try a first version?

a.zh: 试点通常在 2–6 周内交付首个可用版本，具体周期取决于范围与数据接入条件。
a.en: A pilot typically delivers a first working version in 2–6 weeks, depending on scope and data access.
